More bookings from the same ad spend.

We find where your ads, pages and follow-up lose buyers between the click and the booking, then fix it.

Free. A 2-minute video of your own ads and pages, within a day.

Bookdzilla is an AI marketing agency for high-ticket local businesses.

Venues, schools, clinics, senior living communities and home service companies in the United States pay for clicks and calls, then lose most of them before a booking. We fix that path, so the leads you already pay for turn into tours, consults and jobs on your calendar.

Wedding venues

More booked tours.

Most venues do not have a lead problem. They pay for ads and listings, the inquiries come in, and couples drift away before the tour.

Wedding venues
Senior living communities

More booked tours.

The family member doing the research is usually an adult child with a job, looking in the evening or on a Sunday. What happens in the first hour decides which communities they visit.

Senior living
Private schools

More booked campus tours.

Most schools get inquiries. Fewer turn them into tours, and fewer still keep a family warm from the tour to the application deadline.

Private schools
Dental implant and cosmetic practices

More booked consults.

High-value cases are won or lost before the patient ever sits in the chair.

Dental practices
Med spas

More booked appointments.

Demand is rarely the problem. The leaks sit between the ad and the appointment, and between the first visit and the second.

Med spas
Pool builders

More booked design visits.

With fewer pools being built, the builders who have a good year are rarely the ones who spend the most on ads. They turn more of the clicks they already pay for into design visits.

Pool builders
Roofing contractors

More booked inspections.

Roofing leads are urgent, and the phone rings while the crew is on a roof.

Roofing
HVAC and home services

More booked jobs.

In peak season the phones cannot keep up. In the slow season the customer list sits untouched.

How it starts.

A free video first. $1,000 a month only if you want the fixes built.

  1. A free leak check

    Send your website. Within a day you get a 2-minute video of where your ads and pages lose people. No call needed.

  2. We fix the path

    We record your last 30 days of leads, bookings and response time. Then the fixes go live, usually within 14 days. You approve everything first.

  3. Month to month

    $1,000 a month plus a one-time setup fee of $300 to $400. No contract. Your ad budget goes straight to Meta or Google. See pricing

See the whole process

What we build with.

Proven tools, connected into one system that answers calls, follows up and books for you. You do not have to learn any of them.

  • GoHighLevel

    CRM, texting, follow-up, booking, missed-call text back and the AI receptionist, in one place.

  • Clay

    Finds, cleans and enriches your customer list so old leads can be segmented and brought back.

  • Claude

    Writes first replies, follow-ups, ads and pages in your voice, from your prices and policies.

  • Meta Ads and Google Ads

    Campaigns, creative and tracking, so every booking traces back to the ad that paid for it.

  • Calendly

    Bookings land on your real calendar, with reminders before every appointment.

  • Cloudflare

    Landing pages that load in about a second on a phone.

Questions owners ask.

  • How much does it cost?

    $1,000 a month, plus a one-time setup fee of $300 to $400 depending on how much we connect. Your ad budget stays separate and goes straight to Meta or Google.

  • Is there a contract?

    No. It is month to month.

  • Do I need new software or to change how my team works?

    No. We set everything up and connect it to the phone, calendar and tools you already use.

  • What about my old leads?

    We bring them back. Past inquiries and customers get a reactivation campaign, so revenue comes from people you have already paid for.

  • Who owns everything?

    You do: the ad accounts, the pages and every contact, even if you stop.

  • How long until it is live?

    The leak check video arrives within a day. If you go ahead, the fixes are live in about 14 days.
